title: ClientEvent (SPEC.md §6.2)
description: One message from the app frontend to the agent, in the JSON encoding of the envelope (SPEC.md §6, §6.2). Each message is a JSON object whose `type` names the variant in snake_case; the variant's fields sit beside `type`. The envelope evolves additively within a major version (SPEC.md §13): receivers ignore fields they do not know, so no message here sets `additionalProperties: false`. Kept in step with `ClientEvent` in crates/cleverhans-core/src/envelope.rs by crates/cleverhans-core/tests/spec_schemas.rs.

Init.title: Init
Init.description: Opens the session; MUST be the first message on a stream (SPEC.md §6.1).

spec_version.description: Protocol version the client speaks (SPEC.md §13). The agent accepts a version with the same major.minor prefix on a segment boundary, e.g. `0.1`, `0.1.0` or `0.1.0-draft` for `0.1`.

context_seq.description: Client-monotonic sequence number (unsigned 64-bit); proposals record the snapshot they were built against (SPEC.md §6.4).

ConfirmAction.title: ConfirmAction
ConfirmAction.description: The user confirms a proposal. Triggers confirm-time revalidation and execution (SPEC.md §7.3).

RejectAction.title: RejectAction
RejectAction.description: The user declines a proposal. Terminal for that proposal.

reason.description: Optional reason, fed back to the model as conversation context. Absent and null both mean no reason.

Context.title: Context
Context.description: A context snapshot, app → agent (SPEC.md §6.2): the reference shape of the app seam of SPEC.md §9.5. Context flows one way and is the only channel through which context-sourced params are filled. Unknown fields are ignored; app-defined additions belong in `extensions`.

params.description: Route or view parameters. Absent means an empty map.

selected_record_id.description: Current selection, if any. Absent and null both mean no selection.

view_type.description: View kind, e.g. `"detail"` or `"list"`. Absent and null both mean unknown.

extensions.description: App-defined additions. Absent means an empty map.
